title: Time tiles don't overlap; Needs readings crosses them
custom_preconds:
1. You are signed in as a service advisor (view customers; edit customers to raise a work order), on the build under test.
  2. Open Customers from the top navigation and switch to its "Maintenance reminders" tab. For the location cases use a two-workplace org (on a one-workplace org the location filter is absent).
  3. Assets with meter-driven services that lack usable readings, plus calendar-only services. Seed: enrol assets on meter-watching services with no readings, and some on calendar-only services.
custom_steps:
1. Select two time tiles and confirm both sets show.
  2. Select Needs readings together with a time tile and read what shows.
  3. Identify what makes a row count toward Needs readings (no reading / one reading / uncomparable), and confirm a calendar-only service never counts.
  4. Hover the (i) on the Needs readings tile.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • The three time tiles do not overlap, and selecting two shows both; Needs readings crosses them - selected with a time tile it shows assets with a row in each, with every matching row.
  • A row counts toward Needs readings when its service watches mileage or engine hours and that meter has no usable pair of readings (none, only one, or uncomparable); the row still shows its calendar date, and a calendar-only service never counts.
  • On the design the (i) reads "A meter with no reading, or not enough readings to measure a rate. The calendar date still shows, and every action stays available."

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-3780, story SV-10570 (S13, The maintenance reminders worklist), Chunk 1 MR (Confluence 886931488) as edited 5 October 2026, S13 (unchanged requirements); Design board "Chunk 1.dc.html" (MR V2 Claude Design project, version of 6 October 2026), artboard S1; read 6 Oct 2026. Source-verified 6 October 2026; not yet build-verified.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S13-R20: “The three time tiles do not overlap, and selecting two shows both. Needs readings crosses them: selected with a time tile it shows the assets that have a row in each, with every matching row”
  • S13-R22: “A row counts toward Needs readings when its service watches mileage or engine hours and that meter has no usable pair of readings: no reading, only one, or none that can be compared. The row still shows its calendar date. A calendar-only service never counts”
  • Design board, artboard S1 (Needs readings (i)): “A meter with no reading, or not enough readings to measure a rate. The calendar date still shows, and every action stays available.”
